question: The approximate value of {5 +{8² times (30 div 5 )} over 48} - {14 over 7} is:
solution:
Concept:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a7829bd8d266adaca3a84b890fadd7fcb778f4a47fb02cdfe5d3cf66e6c38b4.png] 

Calculation:

 {5 +{8² times (30 div 5 )} over 48} - {14 over 7} 

⇒ {5 +{8² times 6} over 48} - 2 

⇒ {5 +{64 times 6} over 48} - 2 

⇒ {5 +384 over 48} - 2 

⇒ 389-96 over 48

⇒ 389-96 over 48 = 6.11 ≈ 6

∴ The answer is 6.
